{{Quote|We were holding territory on Denon. Locals rioted, and orders were to open fire until they stopped. None of us even wanted to be there.. massacring civilians? That's not how Zakuul is supposed to operate.|Koth Vortena|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] was '''occupied''' during the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of the known galaxy. After the Eternal Empire defeated the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in orbit, non-[[Skytrooper]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] personnel were sent down to the surface. After the locals began rioting, Captain [[Koth Vortena]] and his men were ordered to fire on protesting civilians, an order they did not agree with. The experience caused Vortena and [[Len Parvek]] to defect from the Eternal Empire and joining an opposition to the Emperor [[Arcann]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
